leads.jd:
About Ume Intelligence
 Ume Intelligence is a marketing science company solving complex commercial problems for multi-location restaurant brands. We build modern analytics and automation infrastructure, paired with hands-on digital operations that turn operational data into measurable revenue.
 We operate as a lean, high-leverage team with no walls between engineering and operations. We look for people who run toward technology, automation, and data models rather than away from them, and who judge their work by business impact rather than activity.
 The Role
 We are looking for a Business Operations Manager to work directly with our two co-founders in the Founders’ Office.
 This is a high-leverage generalist role. On a given day you might schedule five candidate interviews, reconcile last month’s expenses, file a state registration, pull an enriched list of 40 restaurant groups to prospect, and research a new vendor before lunch. You will take whole areas of work off the founders’ plates, run them reliably, and turn the repeatable parts into checklists, templates, and automations so they get easier every month.
 You will see the whole company up close: hiring, finance, sales, marketing, and compliance. For the right person, the role grows with the company into building and leading business operations as an executive function.
 Who This Role Is For (and Not For)
 This role is for you if: You view no operational task as too small, but you never treat them as permanent manual chores—you treat them as systems to streamline, automate, and document. You take genuine pride in zero dropped balls, meticulous back-office execution, and returning hours of time to executive leadership.
 This role is not for you if: You are looking for a purely advisory/strategy consulting seat, or conversely, a traditional executive assistant role centered around personal calendar coordination. This is hands-on operational infrastructure building across legal, finance, recruiting, and GTM.

 Recruiting Coordination: Run our applicant pipeline end-to-end in our ATS: candidate communication, interview scheduling across time zones, scorecard hygiene, and follow-ups. Prepare offer paperwork and drive new hire onboarding and offboarding workflows.

leads.title: Founder's Office
leads.jd:
About Roligt Foods 
 Roligt Foods is building a next gen clean label beverage brand out of Hyderabad. We make drinks with short, honest ingredient lists and nothing we cannot defend. We are pre-launch, running live activations across the city and rolling out smart vending kiosks. As we scale, we are building a small team that owns outcomes, not tasks.
 The role 
 This role in the Founder's Office works directly with the founder and sees the whole business. Based in Hyderabad, you track every vertical (kiosks, events, brand, sales, production and finance), spot what is slipping and push it to closure. You run the operating rhythm of the company and take on the problems that do not have an owner yet. This role suits someone who wants to learn how a consumer business is run end to end, and is comfortable being held to outcomes early.
 What you will do 
 Track the weekly numbers of every vertical: kiosk sales and uptime, events and leads, brand, production and cash.
 Run the weekly leadership review. Prepare the dashboard, capture decisions and chase every action to closure.
 Own special projects for the founder: new channels, partnerships, pricing and launch plans.
 Do the first-pass analysis on business questions and come back with a recommendation, not just data.
 Work with the kiosk, events, brand and finance leads to unblock work that sits between teams.
 Prepare investor, board and partner material: decks, memos and updates.
 Lead the Generalist Interns in the Founder's Office and review their work.
 You will do well here if you have 
 An MBA (final year or recent graduate) or an undergraduate degree from a strong programme. Any stream. Up to 3 years of experience in consulting, startups, FMCG or operations is a plus.
 Strong Excel or Google Sheets and clear structured thinking. You can build a simple model and explain it.
 Clear, short writing. You can turn a messy discussion into a one-page note.
 Comfort moving between strategy and execution in the same day.
 High ownership and the discipline to follow up until things are done.
 What we offer 
 Fair, competitive pay in line with industry standards, based on your experience and track record.
 Fast-track growth. You work directly with the founder and see a consumer business built from zero.
 Broad exposure across product, brand, events, retail and operations.
 Real ownership. Small team, fast decisions. Your work shows up in the numbers.
 Please do not apply if 
 You are not based in, or not willing to relocate to, Hyderabad.
 You want a fixed job description that never changes.
 You are not comfortable working closely with the founder and being challenged on your work.
 How to apply 
 Apply with your resume. At the top of your resume, add two lines on one problem you owned end to end and what the result was.
 We are selective about who we hire. If you do not hear back within three weeks of applying, please assume your application has not been taken forward this time.

 In this role, you will own the end-to-end growth, performance, and customer experience of our credit products. Working closely with the founding and leadership team, you will operate in a fast-paced, early-stage environmentwearing multiple hats across product, risk, growth, partnerships, and operations. You will be the key bridge between internal teams and external financial institutions to build, scale, and optimize our consumer lending portfolio from the ground up. This is a high-impact opportunity for someone excited to create, experiment, and drive meaningful outcomes while shaping the financial journeys of millions of consumers.
 Responsibilities: 
 Drive Business Growth: Own and scale key business metrics, including user acquisition, conversion, activation, retention, and revenue growth across lending products and customer segments.
 Optimize Customer Journeys: Map, analyze, and continuously improve end-to-end customer journeys, onboarding funnels, and product experiences to drive higher engagement and conversion rates.
 Lead GTM and Growth Initiatives: Design and execute go-to-market strategies, growth experiments, and targeted campaigns to expand customer reach and unlock new growth opportunities.
 Manage Strategic Partnerships: Build and strengthen relationships with external partners, financial institutions, and ecosystem stakeholders to enable seamless business operations and scalable integrations.
 Drive Ecosystem and Vendor Excellence: Identify, evaluate, and manage third-party platforms, technology providers, and operational partners to enhance customer experience, risk management, and operational efficiency.
 Requirements: 
 B. Tech/B. E. or MBA from a Tier-1 institute.
 1-5 years of experience in category management/product operations in a fast-paced environment.
 Ecommerce, fintech, or B2C ecosystem. Proven track record in fast-paced, early-stage startups.
 Expertise in Data and Analytics (Advanced Excel and SQL).
 Clear grasp of digital KYC, risk underwriting, and B2C loan lifecycles.
 About GoodScore
 GoodScore is a leading credit score management app that empowers over 5 million Indians to build their credit score to 750+. We are one of the youngest apps in the top 20 finance apps in India. Powered by RBI-authorized credit bureaus Experian and CRIF High Mark, GoodScore provides comprehensive credit monitoring and improvement solutions.
 Our app delivers personalized credit insights through detailed video analysis and step-by-step improvement plans. Users can regularly check their credit scores, access detailed reports, and receive expert guidance on managing their credit health. A strong credit score through GoodScore opens doors to loan and credit card opportunities from India's top financial institutions. Based in Bengaluru, GoodScore is committed to financial education and empowerment, helping Indians achieve greater financial freedom through improved credit health.

Supply Chain Manager , SILT Nutrition, Bengaluru (in office, full-time).
 We hire for four things: ownership, intent, the ability to learn and unlearn, and a generalist attitude. At this 0 to 1 stage, relatively empty slates eager to wear many hats are welcome.
 Experience: ideally 5 to 8 years, but ownership, intent, learning speed and a generalist attitude matter more than years.
 Production, operations, logistics, purchase. End to end, CDMO to doorstep.
 About SILT Nutrition 
 SILT makes evidence-based daily wellness rituals for India's busy professionals. Two drink mixes: SILT Mornings (gut + energy + vitamins) and SILT Nights (recovery + calm + sleep). Clinical doses, every mg printed on the pack, no proprietary blends.
 We opened the cart on 28 October 2026. Three weeks in: 248 orders, 1,870 pre-bookers, ~90% organic, rated 4.9/5 by verified buyers. Four of us did that. SILT is not short of demand. It is short of hands.
 What you will own 
 Own production planning with our CDMO: forecasts, batches, raw materials and packaging
 Own purchase: vendors, MOQs, costs and lead times
 Own logistics and 3PL: inventory, dispatch, returns and marketplace readiness
 Keep stock, COGS and quality on one sheet: COAs, batch records, FSSAI compliance
 Build the ops playbook as we scale to marketplaces and quick commerce
 Pitch in beyond your role: content, ops, customer calls, whatever ships
 What you bring 
 Supply chain or operations experience at any FMCG or D2C brand. No wellness background needed
 Experience working with contract manufacturers and 3PLs
 Strong with numbers: inventory planning, costing and working capital
 Bonus: exposure to food or beverage manufacturing
 Who we're looking for 
 You don't need a wellness background: the best D2C and FMCG operators learn this category fast. Numbers over adjectives, and the habit of reading the label.
 What you get 
 An early seat at the table in a 0 to 1 consumer brand
 Every number in the open
 Direct work with the founders
 Full-time, in office, Bengaluru
 How to apply 
 Apply here: https://tinyurl.com/silt-jobs (or write to careers@drinksilt.com with the role in the subject line). The question that matters most: what would you fix about SILT in your first 30 days? That answer matters more than the CV.
Seniority level Mid-Senior level | Employment type Full-time | Industries Wellness and Fitness Services

Define how companies run the software their own people build with AI.
 The role
 A new category is being born: software built by everyone in a company, not just engineers. Someone has to define how it should work, for the builder who wants their app live today, for the IT leader who has to say yes, and for everyone who uses what gets built.
That is you. You will own the core Isomorph product, working directly with the founders, engineers and customers, and you will shape a category, not just a roadmap.
 What You’ll Own
 The builder’s journey, from first idea to a live app, and to the hundredth app after it.
 The experience for IT and admins: control, visibility and trust across everything a company builds.
 How builders discover Isomorph on their own and bring their whole company along.
 Turning everything we do by hand for customers today into product.
 What You’ll Get To Build Next
 Grow Isomorph from the way apps get to production into the place where all of a company’s software lives.
 Define how Isomorph keeps every app healthy, secure and cost-efficient on its own.
 You’ll thrive here if
 You have been a product manager, founder or product-minded engineer on a developer, infrastructure or B2B platform.
 You build with AI tools yourself, and you can go deep with engineers.
 You understand what it takes to win an enterprise’s trust.
 You write clearly, decide with evidence and say no often.
 Why Isomorph
 For fifty years, software inside a company has been written by a small group of engineers, for everyone else. That is ending. With AI, the people who know the work best (the finance analyst, the ops lead, the recruiter, the support manager) can now build the software they need themselves. Most of them have never written a line of code.
This is one of the biggest shifts in how companies work, and it has a missing piece. The software these people build is useful, and very often unsafe: no sign-in, sensitive data exposed, nobody to run it, and invisible to IT. Multiply that across a large company and you get thousands of apps and agents that nobody governs.
 Isomorph is the foundation that software runs on. Bring an app or agent built with any AI tool, and Isomorph runs it on the company’s own cloud: secured, connected to company data and systems, monitored and kept healthy. Builders never think about infrastructure. IT stays in control of everything.
We believe every company will become AI-native one workflow at a time, built by its own people. Isomorph is where that software will live.
 The team. You will join a small, high-talent-density founding team from IIT Madras and IIT Delhi. The founders are second-time founders who have built companies before and sold one.
 Why you’ll love it here
 You’ll be early. You will be one of the first people on the team, with real ownership and a real say in what Isomorph becomes.
 You’ll work at the frontier. AI agents and enterprise-grade infrastructure, applied to a problem every company is about to have.

leads.title: FirstClub - Product Manager - Supply Chain
leads.jd:
About FirstClub
 At FirstClub, we are building a new kind of quick commerce from the ground up, and the supply chain is where that promise is won or lost.
The Supply Chain Product team builds the systems that decide what we buy, where it sits, how it moves and what we promise each member.
Every order that reaches a member on time, fresh and complete is the output of our products.
 The Team's Charter Spans The Full Supply Chain
 Buying & Sourcing : demand-led purchase planning, vendor management, PO lifecycle and inbound scheduling.
 Collection Centers : first-mile intake, quality checks, grading and consolidation of fresh and farm produce.
 Distribution Centers (DCs) : inbound, putaway, storage, picking, packing, outbound and returns.
 Middle Mile : DC-to-Club House replenishment, trip planning, vehicle utilization and inventory movement.
 Club Houses : receiving, storage, pick-pack, cycle counts, freshness and wastage control.
 Inventory Management : single source of truth for stock, ageing and expiry, replenishment and inventory accuracy across nodes.
 Capacity Management : labor, slot, storage and throughput planning across nodes and time of day.
 Promise Engine : what we promise each member - availability and delivery ETA - based on live inventory and capacity.
 Why FirstClub
 Build, don't babysit : Much of our supply chain stack is being built right now. You will design core systems, not just tune someone else's.
 Small team, big surface area : You'll own outcomes that would sit with a whole team at a larger company.
 Fast loops : Ship on Monday, watch it run on a Club House floor by Wednesday, improve it by Friday.
 Ground truth over slide decks : Our PMs spend real time in DCs, Collection Centers and Club Houses, not just in dashboards.
 Scrappy beats perfect : We'd rather run a pilot this week than polish a plan for next quarter.
 Your fingerprints on the company : The decisions you make now shape how FirstClub scales to every new city.
 The Role
 As a Product Manager on Supply Chain, you will own one or more problem areas across our supply chain end to end, with scope shaped by your strengths and the team's priorities.
You will spend real time on the ground with our operations teams, turn what you see into clear problem statements, and ship tools that make operations faster, more accurate and cheaper.
 What You Will Do
 Own the roadmap, PRDs and delivery for your area, from discovery through launch, adoption and iteration.
 Build process tools for frontline and planning teams that are simple to use, work in real operating conditions and hold up at peak hours.
 Work with Operations to map current workflows, find where time, stock or money is lost, and fix it with product.
 Own and move the core metrics for your area, such as accuracy, productivity, availability, cost and wastage.
 Work across team boundaries so your area connects cleanly with the rest of the supply chain stack.
 Write clear specs and work daily with Engineering, Design, Data and QA to ship on time with quality.
 Define success metrics up front, set up dashboards, run pilots in one or two nodes, and scale what works.
 Drive adoption on the ground : SOP changes, training material and feedback loops with site managers and associates.
 Use AI and automation where they remove manual effort - for example, exception detection, smart nudges to frontline teams, or automated decisions.
 What We Are Looking For
 2 - 5 years of experience in Product Management, or in a product-adjacent role (operations excellence, program management, business analytics, engineering) with at least 1 - 2 years owning product outcomes.
 Experience in quick commerce, e-commerce, food delivery, logistics, warehousing, retail or another operations-heavy business.
 A solid understanding of supply chain or operations workflows, and the curiosity to go deep on new ones quickly.
 Strong first-principles problem solving; you can break a messy operational problem into measurable parts.
 Comfort with data : you write SQL, build your own dashboards and make decisions from numbers.
 Clear written and verbal communication; you can explain a spec to an engineer and a workflow change to a frontline associate.
 Bias for action, high ownership and willingness to spend time on the floor.
 Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Business or a related field. An MBA is a plus but not required.
 Good To Have
 Built or shipped tools used by frontline or operations teams.
 Exposure to WMS, OMS, ERP or procurement systems.
 Experience with fresh, perishable or cold-chain categories, including FEFO and expiry management.
 Exposure to planning, forecasting or optimisation problems.
 Hands-on use of AI tools in product work, or experience shipping ML-driven features.
 (ref:hirist.tech)
Seniority level Not Applicable | Employment type Full-time | Industries Technology, Information and Internet, Software Development, and Technology, Information and Media

Licious is India's most loved meat and seafood brand, founded in 2015 by Abhay Hanjura and Vivek Gupta. We are on a mission to transform the way India consumes meat and seafood by delivering the freshest, highest-quality products directly to consumers.
 We are a technology-driven, consumer-first business that believes quality is our magic ingredient. At Licious, we are constantly innovating, challenging conventions and building processes that enable us to deliver exceptional customer experiences.
 What makes the role meaty? 
 We are looking for an analytical and solution-oriented Assistant Manager – Supply Planning to join our Planning team. In this role, you will manage raw material and fresh product planning, drive material availability and build scalable planning processes.
 You will play a key role in strengthening long-term planning capabilities, driving process automation and improving the efficiency of daily planning operations.
 Manage end-to-end supply planning for raw materials and fresh products, ensuring availability in line with business requirements.

 Drive demand and supply planning activities to ensure optimal material availability and fulfilment.

 Develop automated tracking mechanisms for material availability and fulfilment.
 Leverage data and analytics to identify supply gaps, improve planning accuracy and drive operational efficiencies.
 Work closely with sourcing, procurement and operations teams to ensure seamless planning and execution.
 We hope you have... 
 2+ years of experience in supply planning, demand planning or any related planning function.
 Strong hands-on expertise in SQL, Python, Power BI, Advanced Excel and R.
 Good understanding of demand/supply planning processes and material planning.
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to work with large datasets.
 Experience in automating reports, planning workflows and repetitive processes.
 Ability to collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders and drive process improvements.
 A structured approach to problem-solving and strong attention to detail.
 A degree from a reputed institution (Tier 1 college preferred).

 Understand problems. Build solutions. Take ideas live.
 We are looking for a curious, resourceful builder with 1-3 years of experience to work closely with Volopay's founders on new products, internal tools and automations. You'll help us figure out what to build, why it matters and how to make it work. Then you'll get involved in building it. Some days, you'll be speaking with users and mapping a workflow. The common thread: understand the problem, make thoughtful product decisions and carry the work through to a working solution.
 What you'll work on: 
 Identify problems worth solving: Speak with customers and internal teams, understand their workflows and find where better software can reduce effort or improve outcomes.
 Shape product decisions: Turn business needs and user feedback into clear requirements, user flows and priorities. Decide what belongs in the first version and what can wait.
 Build and test solutions: Use AI coding tools to create functional prototypes and working applications. Test ideas with users and improve them based on what you learn.
 Build internal tools and automations: Improve how teams work by connecting systems, automating repetitive tasks and making information easier to use.
 Work across the technical stack: Understand how the frontend, backend, APIs and databases fit together. Connect services, investigate issues and work with engineering when deeper expertise is needed.
 Take products live and improve them: Own testing, deployment and rollout. Track whether people use what you've built and whether it solves the original problem.
 Execute founder-led initiatives: Take ownership of ambiguous product projects, resolve blockers and drive them from an initial idea to a usable solution.

 1-3 years of experience in product, software development, technical operations, a founder's office or a related role.

 Clear communication: you can explain a problem, a proposed solution and the trade-offs involved.

 Signup and account connection. Signup, business verification, connecting ad accounts on platforms like TikTok and OpenAI, and linking data sources such as pixels and product catalogs.
 Migration. Bringing existing ad accounts, campaigns and spend history into Accelerate, so advertisers keep their learnings and agencies can move clients in bulk.
 Activation. Time to first live campaign and first results. Includes AI-guided onboarding, where the agent helps users finish setup rather than leaving them with a checklist.
 Retention and lifecycle. Nudges, re-engagement, in-product guidance and email or WhatsApp lifecycle flows that bring users back and grow their usage.

About Career Shifts Consulting We’re a leadership, talent, and culture consulting firm. We coach executives, design leadership programmes, and help organisations work through changes in how they manage talent, build capability, and work together. We deliver this work alongside a network of senior coaches and consultants. We also produce the Career Shifts Podcast, where we explore leadership, careers, and the future of work.
What you’ll do Keep client work moving. Track proposals, client commitments, and project deadlines. Coordinate with clients and partners, capture decisions, and make sure each action has an owner and a due date.
 Prepare client-ready material. Research leadership, talent, and culture topics. Turn notes and findings into clear briefs, decks, proposals, and client communications.
 Run the day-to-day work of the Founder’s Office. Manage calendars and meeting logistics, maintain trackers and shared files, and flag issues early. Build simple templates and workflows the team can reuse.
 Support podcast, content, and outreach. Coordinate guests and recordings, help draft content, and keep follow-ups on schedule.
 Help develop new offerings. Support research, special projects, and pilots. Capture what we learn and turn it into material we can use again.
 What you’ll get You’ll see how a consulting business is built from the inside, from the first client conversation to the work we deliver. You’ll work directly with the founder, get exposure to executive coaching, leadership development, and organisational transformation, and own work that clients and colleagues rely on.
What you’ll bring 3+ years of relevant experience in operations, project coordination, consulting support, a founder’s office, HR, strategy, or a similar role.
 Clear writing and sound judgement. You can make sense of messy notes, produce something a client can use, and decide what to handle yourself and what to raise.
 Reliable follow-through. You can manage competing deadlines, work with senior stakeholders, and use discretion with confidential information.
 Comfort with everyday work tools. You can use spreadsheets, presentation software, and collaboration tools. Familiarity with CRM or project management tools is useful.
 A bachelor’s degree in business, psychology, HR, communications, or a related field, and an interest in leadership, coaching, organisational development, or culture. An MBA in HR or other relevant postgraduate study is welcome.
 Availability for full-time hybrid work in Bengaluru , including in-person client meetings and occasional travel for client work.

About the Role 
 As we scale, we're looking for an Executive Assistant to join the Founder's Office. You'll be the Founder's right hand, managing their time, communication and priorities, and making sure decisions turn into action across the company. This is a high-trust, high-visibility role for someone who loves ownership.
 Key Responsibilities 
 • Own the Founder's calendar: schedule meetings, resolve conflicts and protect time for priority work
 • Manage the Founder's bandwidth; calls, draft emails, letters and responses on their behalf
 • Act as the first point of contact for internal teams, investors, government bodies, customers and vendors
 • Prepare agendas, briefing notes and presentations before meetings
 • Take minutes, track action items and follow up with owners until tasks are closed
 • Coordinate across sales, operations, finance and the manufacturing plant
 • Plan domestic and international travel
 • Organise leadership reviews, board meetings, investor visits and events
 • Maintain confidential records of contracts, approvals and key documents
 • Support the Founder on strategic initiatives and special projects
 What We're Looking For
 • Bachelor's degree in any discipline; MBA or business background is a plus
 • 2–5 years of experience as an Executive Assistant, in a Founder's Office or Chief of Staff support role
 • Excellent written and spoken English; Hindi and Telugu are a plus
 • Strong command of MS Office (PowerPoint, Excel, Word, Teams)
 • Highly organised, detail-oriented and able to juggle multiple priorities
 • Proven discretion with confidential information
 • Proactive and calm under pressure; you anticipate needs before you're asked
 • Willing to travel occasionally to Visakhapatnam
 Why Join Us
 • Work directly with the Founder and learn how a medtech manufacturing company is built and run
 • Be part of India's journey to becoming a global medtech manufacturing hub
 • Competitive compensation in line with industry standards
 • A fast-paced environment where ownership is rewarded with growth
 If you're excited to be part of this journey, we'd love to hear from you.

leads.title: Senior Business Development Associate
leads.location: Bengaluru, KA, IN / Bengaluru, Karnataka, IN
leads.jd:
Codingal (www.codingal.com) is the global leader in online AI and coding education for kids and teens (Grades 1-12). Our mission is to help students fall in love with AI & coding and become creators of the future - entrepreneurs, engineers, and scientists by providing high-quality, accessible, and personalized computer science education.

In many countries, top technical universities exist, but there’s a significant gap in K-12 programming education. Parents want their kids to start learning programming early, and that’s why they choose Codingal. We offer live, interactive classes with expert instructors from Computer Science backgrounds. All our instructors are rigorously vetted and trained to ensure a high-quality learning experience.

Every student receives a personalized learning path tailored to their age and skill level. Our curriculum is STEM.org-accredited, aligned with the K–12 Computer Science Framework, and delivered in 1:1 and small-group formats, ensuring individual attention and engagement.

Students learn by building real-world projects using popular tools and technologies like Scratch, Python, Roblox, Minecraft, MIT App Inventor, Thunkable, Pygame, HTML/CSS, JavaScript, website development, Java, Data Science, AP Computer Science content, and AI tools like ChatGPT and Machine Learning frameworks. Through this hands-on approach, students create apps, games, animations, and websites in a fun, engaging way that fosters problem-solving and creative skills.

Beyond classes, students participate in global coding competitions, hackathons like HPE CodeWars, and online coding camps, further nurturing their creativity, confidence, and innovative spirit. With a 4.9/5 student rating and NPS of 86, Codingal is trusted by over 1 million registered students in 70+ countries.

Codingal combines the best of human instruction and AI-driven learning to inspire the next generation of tech leaders. We are poised to lead the next generation of coding education and make a significant impact in this rapidly growing market.
